name: obix-compiler-script
description: The Vue script frontend of the .obix compiler: compiles the normal <script> (JavaScript or TypeScript) of a canonical SFC with the OFFICIAL Vue script compiler (@vue/compiler-sfc compileScript) into a typed frontend artifact — the compiled module, the binding metadata the template stage needs, the imports and the Babel AST — and reports what the compiler says under OBIX-owned diagnostic codes, with file-absolute locations. Also the shared core of the script stages: obix-compiler-script-setup is built on it. Phase 3 of the VueTS compiler recovery (docs/recovery/vuets-compiler.md).
author: Nnamdi Michael Okpala <okpalan@protonmail.com>
